text:
maria: heads-up — we saw a sustained latency bump in eu-west dedicated pool 4 over the last 45m, not a full outage but 95th token P95 jumped 2.3x. digging in now :mag:
liam: any noisy neighbor signals? iops or pcie counters?
sanjay: NVLink error rates are fine. NIC TX drops spiked around the same time, looks like egress queue thrash on a subset of nodes.
elaine: is this the pool we recently packed with fractional slices to hit utilization targets?
maria: yes, we consolidated smaller slices to reduce idle GPUs. hypothesis: fragmentation caused hot-hot spill onto a few phys cards => nvlink/egress saturation.
derek: can we surgical-migrate a couple tenants to the preemptible spill pool to test? want to avoid draining whole hosts.
liam: +1. we have a script to migrate by tenant-id and preserve KV cache prefixes. runbook snippet:
```
# migrate tenant 8734 with graceful handoff
python infra/migrate_tenant.py --tenant 8734 --target-pool preemptible-eu-west --grace-period 60
```
elaine: note: some of those tenants are on dedicated contracts — need ops approval for forced handoff
maria: true. i'll check SLO/contract map. For short term can we do surgical eviction of idle slices only? not full tenant move.
sanjay: we can detect idle slices by last_active_ms < 120000 and zero KV hits in last 10m. safe to preempt those, will free contiguous GPU memory.
derek: cost tradeoff: forcing migrations to preemptible increases egress and transfer ops. Ops-bot, how many migrations have we done this week and what's the average transfer cost?
ops-bot: Weekly migrations: 18, avg data transferred per migration: 420MB, estimated egress cost per migration: $0.032
liam: that's tiny compared to customer impact. recommend: 1) run idle-slice eviction on the 6 most loaded hosts in pool-4 2) if P95 still > target, migrate 2 medium tenants to preemptible 3) open ticket to review packing policy
elaine: can we add a soft-routing rule to avoid placing latency-sensitive routes on hosts with >70% NVLink TX util? that might reduce recurrence.
sanjay: routing tweak is feasible but needs cautious rollout. propose canary for 1 AZ first.
maria: ok doing step 1 now (evict idle slices), i'll post results. tagging @derek for contract exceptions if migration needed.
derek: standing by. if it looks like a pack policy bug, flag for billing so we don't silently violate SLAs.
maria: update 10m: evicted 12 idle slices, freed 36GB across 6 hosts. P95 dropped 35% but still ~1.5x target. proceeding to migrate 2 medium non-critical tenants to preemptible (with consent flag off).
liam: smooth. keep logs and KV cache warming plan; we should add a quick-cache-warm after migration to avoid spike on cold misses.
ops-bot: migration jobs queued: 2. ETA ~4m each.
maria: migrations complete. P95 now within target for pool-4. filing follow-up doc on packing thresholds and adding an alert for NVLink TX > 70% with associated routing hold.
elaine: thanks — can we also add a cost/benefit note to the doc showing egress vs SLA hit? want to include in next infra retrospective.
sanjay: will draft the note. also adding a regular defrag job to preempt only idle slices every night at 03:30 UTC as a low-risk mitigation.
maria: perfect. closing this thread once follow-up doc link exists.
